questions.question: What was Elihu's main argument in chapter 34?
options: God is deeply unjust to the truly innocent man
God is just and repays everyone according to their deeds
Job is righteous and has done no wrong at all
The wicked always prosper greatly and go entirely free
questions.answer: God is just and repays everyone according to their deeds

questions.question: What did Elihu say it is unthinkable for God to do?
options: Speak a word to a suffering man
Rest from his work for a single day
